t: This is the Lloyd's building, home of the insurance institution Lloyd's of London. It stands on the corner of Lime Street and Leadenhall Street, on the former site of East India House, in the heart of the City's financial district. Look at the ducts and lifts. They are on the outside, so the inside stays as open as possible. That is the mark of this radical style. Richard Rogers, founder of the practice now called RSHP, is named as its designer, along with Graham Stirk and Ivan Harbour, who both joined his firm in the 1980s and later became senior partners.
